$comment: clauseProvenance.test.mjs pins the unreviewed backlog at 307 and says in terms that the number
is lowered or raised deliberately. On the deployed tree it is 308, so the suite is red at the
governance level while generation is green.
This is NOT evidence that generation is broken. It is evidence that the review state has crossed
an explicitly established boundary, and the boundary exists to force someone to look.

finding.library: 308 clauses loaded, 0 reviewed, 166 awaiting review, 142 unmarked
finding.generation_impact: none — goldenCorpus is green on the same tree

what_crossed_it.name: Personnel Resourcing and Employment Status
what_crossed_it.$method: git log --diff-filter=A over knowledge-base/clause_library. It is the only clause that commit added.
legal_basis: Code on Wages, 2019 s.43 — responsibility for payment of wages rests with the employer
Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 s.8A

was_it_legitimately_admitted.reading: Yes, on the evidence. It is a substantive authored clause carrying statutory basis and a review status, not an accidental or duplicated record. Nothing suggests it was admitted by mistake.
was_it_legitimately_admitted.consequence: The correct response is therefore a deliberate raise of the ceiling to 308, or getting this clause reviewed so the backlog returns to 307. It is NOT a removal.
was_it_legitimately_admitted.$not_done_here: Neither has been done. Raising a pinned ceiling is the act the pin exists to make deliberate, and a probe is not entitled to perform it.

$note: Worth recording because it is one story rather than three. Commit b9115549e introduced:
canonicalFacts.js (new, 257 lines) — reading a semantic_facts.json that was never added
documentRequirements.js (+50)      — the kind guard and the semantic-fact guard
A large change landed with its guards but without the knowledge those guards require, and
without the ceiling being moved for the clause it brought in. Every document type stopped
generating, and the review backlog crossed its boundary, from one commit.
the_same_commit_caused_the_outage.lesson_already_recorded: A_GREEN_SUITE_MUST_NAME_THE_TREE_IT_RAN_ON — the suite would have caught both on the day, had it been run where the change landed.

decision_required.question: Raise the pinned ceiling to 308, or get SERVICE_PERSONNEL_STATUS_001 reviewed?
decision_required.$constraint: The test must not decide which. Its job is to stop the number moving without someone choosing.
